featureCoding.title: HIDDEN FEATURE UNLOCK & UDS CODING
featureCoding.content: Powered by our ISO 14229 UDS Protocol Engine, safely toggle features like US Parking Lights, Needle Sweep, Horn Ack Lock, Comfort Windows, and DRL settings for VAG, BMW, Renault, and Dacia vehicles.

multiEcu.title: MULTI-ECU ALL MODULE SCANNING
multiEcu.content: Scan and clear fault codes beyond the Engine ECU — including ABS, Airbag, Automatic Transmission (TCU), Instrument Cluster, Climate Control (HVAC), and Body Control Modules (BCM).

advancedDiagnostics.title: DCT ADAPTATION, DPF & HP POWER GAUGE
advancedDiagnostics.content:
• DCT / DSG Clutch Kiss Point Learning & Adaptation Reset
• DPF Soot Load (%/g) & Exhaust Regeneration Temp Monitoring
• Real-time Short/Long Term Fuel Trims (STFT/LTFT) & Lambda Analysis
• Dynamic Horsepower (HP) & Torque (Nm) Live Telemetry Graph

demoMode.title: DEMO MODE (SIMULATION)
demoMode.content: Test and explore the app without physical OBD2 hardware. Experience full CAN-Bus and UDS diagnostic features with realistic real-time telemetry simulation.

live.title: LIVE MONITORING SENSORS
live.content:
Monitor RPM, Speed, Engine Temperature, Throttle Position, Battery Voltage, Engine Load, Intake Air Temperature, and Manifold Pressure (MAP) in real-time.

Values refresh 1-5 times per second depending on Bluetooth speed. You can interact directly with the vehicle via UDS / OBD commands in the terminal.

expertise.title: DIAGNOSTICS & WARRANTY
expertise.content:
The app uses ECU codes to detect faults. VIN and recorded mileage are retrieved.

Additionally, distance traveled with the Check Engine light is calculated to determine hitstorical faults. Reports can be shared via PDF or messaging platforms.

tests.title: BATTERY / PERFORMANCE TESTS
tests.content:
Battery test consists of 3 stages: Resting, Cranking, and Idle Charge tests to measure battery/regulator health.

Performance test measures 0-60 and 0-100 km/h acceleration values with 50ms margin of error using your phone's processor and vehicle's live speed data.

hardware.title: HARDWARE COMPATIBILITY
hardware.content: ELM327 Bluetooth (v1.5) is recommended. Some advanced codes may not work with low-quality v2.1 CLONE hardware. Get highest speed with premium adapters like vLinker and OBDLink.

warnings.title: IMPORTANT WARNINGS
warnings.content:
• Ignition must be ON, Engine must be OFF during trouble code clearing or ECU Reset.
• Do not send Reset to a running vehicle.
• Not every vehicle may support all sensors, unsupported sensors show "--".

onboarding.title: LEGAL PERMISSIONS & ANONYMOUS TELEMETRY
onboarding.content:
To improve application quality and vehicle compatibility, completely anonymized engine parameters and diagnostic trouble codes (excluding personal data and VIN) captured during diagnostics may be analyzed on our secure servers. By proceeding, you agree to these anonymous telemetry terms.

Bluetooth and Location permissions are required to establish a connection with your motorcycle's ECU.

battery.title: BATTERY & CRANKING TEST
battery.restingStatus: Ignition on, engine off... Reading battery voltage...
battery.crankingStatus: START THE ENGINE NOW! (5 seconds measurement)
battery.voltageError: Voltage could not be read. Check the connection.

steps.1: 1. Ignition on, engine off → Resting voltage measured
steps.2: 2. Start the engine when "START THE ENGINE NOW" appears
steps.3: 3. Lowest voltage during startup is recorded (5s)
steps.4: 4. Charging/regulator voltage measured with engine running

battery.warning: Do not disconnect Bluetooth during the test.

freeze.title: FREEZE FRAME
freeze.desc: Reads engine parameters at the moment the Check Engine light turned on. This data provides critical info for diagnosis.

freeze.noData: No freeze frame data found. Vehicle may not support this feature.
freeze.techDesc:
• OBD-II Mode 02: Freeze Frame Data
• PID 020C00: RPM at fault
• PID 020D00: Speed at fault
• PID 020500: Coolant temp at fault

This data belongs to the last fault code. Clearing codes will also clear freeze frame data.

perf.title: PERFORMANCE TEST
perf.idle: Press the button and prepare to move.
perf.howDesc:
1. Press "Start Test" button
2. Vehicle must be stationary (Speed = 0)
3. Timer starts automatically when you move
4. 0-60 km/h and 0-100 km/h times are recorded

⚠️ Perform this test in a safe area!

hyundai_one_touch_turn_7_flashes.name: One-Touch Lane Change Signal (7 Flashes)
hyundai_one_touch_turn_7_flashes.desc: Sets one-touch lane change blinker duration to 7 flashes.

hyundai_svm_camera_speed_extend.name: 360° Surround Camera Speed Extension (20 km/h)
hyundai_svm_camera_speed_extend.desc: Keeps 360-degree parking camera active up to 20 km/h forward speed.

hyundai_n_performance_exhaust_flap.name: N-Performance Exhaust Flap Default OPEN
hyundai_n_performance_exhaust_flap.desc: Sets active exhaust valve default position to OPEN on engine start.

vag_rain_closing_sunroof.name: Rain Closing (Regenschließen)
vag_rain_closing_sunroof.desc: Automatically closes sunroof and windows when rain is detected while parked.

bmw_launch_control_unlock.name: Launch Control Unlock
bmw_launch_control_unlock.desc: Unlocks factory launch control acceleration program in transmission ECU.

mercedes_ambient_64_multi_zone.name: 64-Color Multi-Zone Ambient Profile
mercedes_ambient_64_multi_zone.desc: Unlocks dynamic multi-zone color cycle animation in MBUX interior lighting.

ford_trailer_brake_activation.name: Trailer Brake Controller (TBC) Enable
ford_trailer_brake_activation.desc: Enables integrated trailer brake controller menu in instrument cluster.

gm_afm_dfm_cylinder_deactivation_disable.name: AFM/DFM V8 Cylinder Lock (No V4 Drop)
gm_afm_dfm_cylinder_deactivation_disable.desc: Locks engine in 8-cylinder mode permanently to prevent V4 vibration.

gm_remote_start_time_extend.name: Remote Start Duration Extension (20 Mins)
gm_remote_start_time_extend.desc: Extends factory key fob remote engine start run time from 10 to 20 minutes.

dodge_srt_performance_pages.name: SRT Performance Pages & Drive Modes
dodge_srt_performance_pages.desc: Unlocks Uconnect 0-100 acceleration timers, G-force meter, and launch control.

ram_bambi_mode_fog.name: RAM Truck Fog Lights with High Beam
ram_bambi_mode_fog.desc: Allows RAM fog lights to remain active alongside high beam headlights.

byd_avas_pedestrian_siren_mute.name: AVAS EV Low-Speed Siren Mute
byd_avas_pedestrian_siren_mute.desc: Mutes low-speed artificial electric motor siren below 30 km/h.

chery_isa_overspeed_chime_mute.name: ISA Overspeed Warning Chime Deactivation
chery_isa_overspeed_chime_mute.desc: Disables continuous 80/120 km/h overspeed warning beep on Tiggo/MG models.

mg_ev_battery_preconditioning_toggle.name: EV Fast-Charge Battery Pre-Heating Manual Switch
mg_ev_battery_preconditioning_toggle.desc: Enables manual battery pre-heating switch before DC fast charging.

chery_dms_fatigue_camera_mute.name: Driver Monitoring (DMS) Camera Sensitivity Reduction
chery_dms_fatigue_camera_mute.desc: Reduces over-sensitive eye-tracking fatigue warnings on steering column.

honda_walk_away_auto_lock.name: Walk-Away Auto Door Lock
honda_walk_away_auto_lock.desc: Automatically locks all doors when driver steps 2 meters away with key fob.

subaru_avh_auto_hold_memory.name: Auto Vehicle Hold (AVH) Memory Mode
subaru_avh_auto_hold_memory.desc: Remembers AVH brake hold ON/OFF state across ignition cycles.

volvo_start_stop_default_off.name: Auto Start-Stop Default OFF Mode
volvo_start_stop_default_off.desc: Sets Start-Stop engine shutoff system default state to OFF upon vehicle start.

volvo_polestar_digital_theme.name: Polestar Blue Digital Cluster Theme
volvo_polestar_digital_theme.desc: Unlocks Polestar signature blue dynamic gauge theme in Volvo driver display.

vag_virtual_cockpit_r_theme.name: Virtual Cockpit R / S / Cupra Performance Themes
vag_virtual_cockpit_r_theme.desc: Unlocks R-Line, S-Line, and Cupra central tachometer performance themes in digital cockpit.

vag_sound_symposer_mute.name: Sound Symposer Fake Engine Noise Deactivation
vag_sound_symposer_mute.desc: Deactivates cabin speaker fake engine sound generator for pure exhaust note.

vag_wireless_carplay_enable.name: Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Activation
vag_wireless_carplay_enable.desc: Enables 5GHz Wi-Fi wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on MIB2.5/MIB3 units.

vag_offroad_telemetry_menu.name: MIB Offroad Telemetry & Gauge Display
vag_offroad_telemetry_menu.desc: Displays steering angle, oil temp, coolant temp, and altitude gauges on MIB screen.

vag_easy_entry_driver_seat.name: Automatic Easy Entry Power Seat Back-step
vag_easy_entry_driver_seat.desc: Moves electric driver seat back 5 cm upon door opening for easy vehicle entry.

vag_hba_memory_state.name: High-Beam Assist (HBA) Memory Retention
vag_hba_memory_state.desc: Remembers High-Beam Assist ON status across ignition restart cycles.

vag_battery_soc_display.name: Battery State of Charge (% SOC) Display
vag_battery_soc_display.desc: Shows exact battery charge percentage (% SOC) on instrument cluster when trip button is held.

bmw_idrive7_m_animation.name: iDrive 7 / 8 M-Performance Startup Animation
bmw_idrive7_m_animation.desc: Changes iDrive screen boot graphic to M-Performance or M-GmbH logo animation.

bmw_bowers_wilkins_audio_profiles.name: Bowers & Wilkins 3D Sound Engine Unlock
bmw_bowers_wilkins_audio_profiles.desc: Unlocks Bowers & Wilkins Concert, Studio, and Stage DSP audio profiles on HiFi systems.

bmw_hitch_zoom_camera.name: Reverse Camera Trailer Hitch Zoom Mode
bmw_hitch_zoom_camera.desc: Unlocks top-down trailer hitch alignment zoom mode on reverse camera view.

bmw_secure_idle_protection.name: Secure Idle Engine Shift-Lock Protection
bmw_secure_idle_protection.desc: Locks transmission in Park if driver leaves running vehicle with key fob.

bmw_seatbelt_handover_mute.name: Coupe Electric Seatbelt Handover Arm Deactivation
bmw_seatbelt_handover_mute.desc: Disables motorized seatbelt extender arm on 4 Series and 2 Series Coupes.

bmw_auto_heat_threshold_5c.name: Automatic Seat & Steering Wheel Heating Temperature (+5°C)
bmw_auto_heat_threshold_5c.desc: Triggers automatic seat and steering wheel heating when ambient temp drops below 5°C.

mercedes_amg_track_pace_unlock.name: MBUX AMG Track Pace Telemetry & Lap Timer
mercedes_amg_track_pace_unlock.desc: Unlocks lap timing, acceleration telemetry, and G-force graphs on MBUX screen.

mercedes_drive_mode_last_memory.name: Dynamic Select Last Drive Mode Memory
mercedes_drive_mode_last_memory.desc: Remembers last selected Drive Mode (Individual / Sport) across vehicle restart.

mercedes_proximity_360_camera_auto.name: Proximity Sensor Auto 360° Camera View
mercedes_proximity_360_camera_auto.desc: Automatically switches screen to 360 camera when front sensors detect obstacle < 50 cm.

ford_sync_climate_screen_unlock.name: SYNC3 / SYNC4 Touchscreen Climate Control Page
ford_sync_climate_screen_unlock.desc: Enables climate control, heated seat, and airflow direction touchscreen page.

ford_turn_signal_5_flashes.name: One-Touch Lane Change Signal (5 Flashes)
ford_turn_signal_5_flashes.desc: Increases one-touch lane change turn signal duration from 3 to 5 flashes.

ford_auto_engine_shutdown_disable.name: 30-Minute Idle Auto Engine Shutdown Override
ford_auto_engine_shutdown_disable.desc: Prevents automatic engine shutoff after 30 minutes idle (for camping/power outlet use).

ev_battery_preheat_manual_switch.name: EV Battery Pre-Heating Manual Switch (Fast DC Charge Prep)
ev_battery_preheat_manual_switch.desc: Allows manual battery pre-heating to 25°C before DC fast charging without navigation route.

ev_v2l_power_output_expand.name: V2L (Vehicle-to-Load) 220V Outlet Power Expansion (3.6 kW)
ev_v2l_power_output_expand.desc: Expands V2L external 220V AC household power outlet limit from 2.2 kW to 3.6 kW.

ev_one_pedal_regen_force_level3.name: One-Pedal Drive Maximum Regenerative Braking Default
ev_one_pedal_regen_force_level3.desc: Sets maximum regenerative braking (One-Pedal stop mode) as default on vehicle start.

byd_soc_max_charge_target_limit.name: BYD Battery Health Protection Max Charge Limit (80% / 90%)
byd_soc_max_charge_target_limit.desc: Sets max AC/DC charge cutoff limit to 80% or 90% to extend Blade Battery lifespan.

byd_dmi_forced_pure_ev_speed_override.name: BYD DM-i Pure EV Mode Gasoline Engine Override
byd_dmi_forced_pure_ev_speed_override.desc: Inhibits gasoline engine start in EV mode up to 130 km/h even during full throttle acceleration.

byd_vtol_v2v_rescue_charge_mode.name: BYD VTOL (Vehicle-to-Vehicle) Rescue Charge Mode
byd_vtol_v2v_rescue_charge_mode.desc: Unlocks external AC power output to charge stranded electric vehicles on road.

hyundai_ipedal_memory_lock.name: Hyundai / Kia i-PEDAL One-Pedal Drive Memory Lock
hyundai_ipedal_memory_lock.desc: Prevents i-PEDAL one-pedal stop mode from dropping back to Level 3 after shifting to Reverse.

hyundai_utility_mode_12v_saver.name: Utility Camping Mode High-Voltage 12V Saver
hyundai_utility_mode_12v_saver.desc: Powers 220V V2L outlet directly from HV traction battery to prevent auxiliary 12V battery drain.

hyundai_phev_no_ice_climate_start.name: PHEV EV Mode Climate Heating Gasoline Engine Suppression
hyundai_phev_no_ice_climate_start.desc: Forces heat pump / PTC electric heater for cabin climate without starting gasoline engine.

vag_taycan_ess_sound_profile_swap.name: Electric Sport Sound (ESS) Taycan / RS e-tron Profile
vag_taycan_ess_sound_profile_swap.desc: Changes electric driving sound profile to Porsche Taycan GTS or Audi RS e-tron GT sound generator.

vag_meb_daily_charge_target_menu.name: MEB Battery Daily 80% / Trip 100% Quick Charge Bar
vag_meb_daily_charge_target_menu.desc: Adds quick toggle bar on MIB screen to switch between 80% daily battery care and 100% trip charge.

vag_gte_generator_charge_reserve.name: GTE / E-Mode Engine Generator Battery Force Charge (80%)
vag_gte_generator_charge_reserve.desc: Forces combustion engine to act as generator to recharge high-voltage battery up to 80% while driving.

bmw_hans_zimmer_iconic_sounds_m.name: Hans Zimmer IconicSounds Electric M-Performance Sound Engine
bmw_hans_zimmer_iconic_sounds_m.desc: Unlocks Hans Zimmer acoustic M-Performance electric acceleration sound profiles on i4 and iX.

bmw_phev_max_edrive_140kmh.name: PHEV MAX eDrive Pure Electric Speed Ceiling (140 km/h)
bmw_phev_max_edrive_140kmh.desc: Increases max pure electric speed ceiling on 330e / 530e Plug-in hybrids to 140 km/h.

bmw_ac_charging_current_limit_menu.name: AC Home Charger Maximum Current Limit Selector (6A - 32A)
bmw_ac_charging_current_limit_menu.desc: Adds AC home charging current limiter (6A / 10A / 16A / 32A) to prevent home circuit overload.

toyota_hybrid_ev_mode_override.name: Toyota / Lexus EV Mode Throttle Override Suppression
toyota_hybrid_ev_mode_override.desc: Prevents gasoline engine from forced start during acceleration when EV mode button is active.

toyota_hybrid_battery_fan_speed_boost.name: Toyota / Lexus High-Voltage Battery Cooling Fan Boost (+30%)
toyota_hybrid_battery_fan_speed_boost.desc: Increases hybrid traction battery cooling fan speed by +30% to prevent thermal degradation in hot climates.

tesla_sentry_high_bitrate_video.name: Tesla Sentry Mode High-Bitrate Continuous Dashcam Recording
tesla_sentry_high_bitrate_video.desc: Increases Sentry Mode camera video recording bitrate for crystal-clear license plate visibility.

tesla_cabin_overheat_threshold_30c.name: Tesla Cabin Overheat Protection Temperature Threshold (30°C)
tesla_cabin_overheat_threshold_30c.desc: Lowers cabin overheat protection climate trigger temperature from 40°C to 30°C for interior preservation.

fuelTrim.title: FUEL TRIM & AIR-FUEL MIXTURE ANALYSIS
fuelTrim.subtitle: STFT & LTFT Diagnostics
fuelTrim.guideDesc: Rich mixture indicates excess fuel in combustion chamber (fuel waste, soot), while Lean mixture indicates excess air (high combustion temp, knock risk).
fuelTrim.causeNormal: System operates within ideal range. No faults.
fuelTrim.causeVacuumLeak: Vacuum leaks, torn hoses, or intake manifold gasket
fuelTrim.causeDirtyMaf: Dirty or faulty MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor
fuelTrim.causeLowFuelPressure: Low fuel pump pressure or clogged fuel filter
fuelTrim.actionCriticalLean: Perform smoke test for intake leaks and clean MAF sensor.
fuelTrim.causeMinorVacuumLeak: Minor air leak or aging O2 sensor
fuelTrim.actionMildLean: Check live O2 sensor data and intake hoses.
fuelTrim.actionCriticalRich: Inspect EVAP purge valve and injector return leak-off.
fuelTrim.actionMildRich: Check or replace engine air filter.

dpf.subtitle: Soot & Ash Mass, Exhaust Gas Temp & Regeneration Status
dpf.recommendNormal: Filter state is optimal. Continue normal driving.
dpf.recommendHighwayDrive: Drive on highway for 20 mins at 2000-2500 RPM.
dpf.recommendServiceRegen: Filter clogged! Service regeneration or cleaning required.
